newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower as harvest gains momentum.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower as harvest gains momentum.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower as the U.S. rice harvest gained momentum amid reports of good yields, traders said.
"The market is being checked by harvest," a trader said.

Prices were underpinned by the strong premium that cash markets hold to the futures, they said. But the U.S. price relationship to Asian values remains high, they said, which also limits attempts to rally the futures market.
Rice closed four cents per cwt lower to three higher, with September down four at $10.26 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 200 contracts, down from 337 contracts Monday, according to the CBOT.
Rice options volume was estimated at 20 contracts, up from 11 Monday.
